senses.gloss:
r. 2nd cl. (तौति or तवति)
1 To go or move.
2 To thrive or increase.
3 To injure, to hurt or kill.
4 To become full. According to some authorities this is merely a Sautra root.

ind.
A particle, implying,
1 Difference, (but, or.)
2 Disjunction, (but, again, further, other.)
3 Connexion, (and, moreover.)
4 Asseveration, (indeed.)
5 An expletive.
